import hashlib
import hmac
import unittest

from auth import InvalidToken, verify


class AuthTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_invalid_signature_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidToken):
            verify("demo", "bad", b"secret")

    def test_valid_signature_is_accepted(self):
        token = "demo"
        signature = hmac.new(b"secret", token.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        self.assertTrue(verify(token, signature, b"secret")["verified"])
